name: Satomura Shiho
source:
Assistant to the director of the St. ReiKura Clinic. She is the right-hand  woman of Dr. Misaki. Although qualified as a doctor, she is not a clinician but a researcher.

She was the first experimental subject of the protagonist's “secret” and thereafter became a collaborator.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=763771]Getchu[/url]]
